sections.text: Instrument + Control
Technical Procedure

Equipment
 Instrumentation Recorders

One Channel, 
 Multi Channel,
 Alpha Log Recorders
Types as mentioned in Introduction
ZPA Nova Paka, Germany, Endress+Hauser
Introduction

This
document out lines the testing proceduresP1, to be performed every six months as 
indicated by M6 in the title block

These testing procedures for
the following Instrumentation Recorders:

One channel recorders type: ZEPAREX 42 t0 45, ZPA Nova Paka, 
and

Multi channel recorders types: 
KS 3870 for 6 Channels, Transokomp 250 for 6 or 12 Channels, 
Piotmaster 100 for 6 Channels,

Their function to record information signal 24 hours round on 
paper roll by modification rear side connection it will be used to receive 
different kinds of signals.
For example signal from RTD or thermocouple or signal from transmitter, this 
connection determines the type of the recorder.

Alpha- log recorder 
multi channel recorders 
(six channels). type 
 BA 048R/09/a6/07.01 no: 50074773, Endress+Hauser

The
display push buttons function as follows:

Button (E) function displays main menu, Button (+) function selects chapter, 
button ( ) ) selects parameter and button ( Θ ) exits from the recent menu & saving
changes.

Signal
measuring 0-20 mA, 4- 20 mA,
0-10 v, thermocouple and RTD measuring also.

The
recorder is provided with digital screen optional to connected
by computer system by using interface unit R 5485.

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Clean
the recorder and oiling it:

Clean
the electric boards by contact cleaner.

Clean
the bearing & shaft and gears by BW40.

Put
paper roll in the same position.

Connect
a power supply
220 V ac.

Select
the recorder to input signal (4 20 ) mA for transmitter.

Inject
mA according to the curve between points 113 and 114
for each channel.
4 mA 8mA 12 mA 16 mA 20 mA

If
the test result satisfies this curve so that the channel is ok, if not ok
adjust from zero potentiometer & span potentiometer and check again up to
no different in the curve or change the amplifier card and check again.

Repeat
the steps (from 4 to 6) for input
signal (0 10) V for thermocouple.

Repeat
the steps ( from 4 to 6 ) for resistance type PT100.

Repeat
the steps (from 1 to 8) for second channel &third channel &forth
channel & etc.

sections.text: Return Recorder to Service

Open
the door of the recorder.

Move
the locking lever to the intermediate position and withdraw it slightly
together with the chassis.

After
that, the chart table is released, turn it slightly forwards and remove it by
withdrawing upwards.

Remove
the locking cardboard insert the motor and the printer.
